text:
helen_peopleops: Quick question before I publish the Q2 review doc: do we enforce a hard cutoff for self-assessments (no late uploads at all), or allow a narrow exception window for contractors and short-term hires? Also, should managers get a 24h buffer to submit comments after the IC deadline? :thinking:

mike_hr: We should allow a narrow exception window but control it. Proposal: 24h buffer for managers, and contractors/new hires get a 72h window if the manager documents the reason (travel, contract timezone, or onboarding tasks). Anything beyond that needs People Ops sign-off.

eng-manager-ryan: 72h for contractors seems fair. One operational ask: can we have a simple checkbox in the form for "contractor/new-hire exception" so uploads are auto-tagged? That makes auditing easier.

calib-lead-sara: Agreed on tagging. For calibration: leads will only include exception-tagged profiles in the redacted pre-read if there's enough evidence; otherwise we'll flag them for a short spot discussion. Also recommend a brief manager training drop-in (15 min) on the rubric before calibrations start.

contractor-ops: Small note from vendor teams: many contractors are on non-US payrolls and need extra time to gather dashboards. 72h helps but can we also allow managers to upload a placeholder note and then a final artifact within the window?

mike_hr: Yes, placeholder notes allowed but mark them as DRAFT. Final artifact must be uploaded before the end of the exception window. We'll require manager acknowledgment in the sheet when placeholders are used.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: managers on the early-review list have drafts due in 48h. Check calendar for invites.

helen_peopleops: Draft checklist I will publish tonight. Short version for managers to forward to teams: "Include top 3 outcomes (data where possible), 1 cross-team impact example, 1 growth goal, and attach 1 artifact. Contractors/new hires: note onboarding status; exceptions may apply. Keep ~200 words"

helen_peopleops: Upload/checklist (short):
```
- IC self-assessments due: 2026-07-15 23:59 UTC
- Manager comments due: 2026-07-16 23:59 UTC (24h buffer)
- Contractor/new-hire exception window: +72h if manager annotated (tag in form)
- Final uploads to /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q2 by: 2026-07-19 12:00 UTC
- Calibration pre-read (redacted) to leads: 2026-07-20 09:00 UTC
- Calibration meetings: week of 2026-07-21 (slots will be posted)
```

mike_hr: I'll add the contractor checkbox to the form and the audit note requirement. Also adding a private flag column for performance-plan cases visible only to HR + leads.

calib-lead-sara: I will run two 15-min rubric refresh sessions: Tue 08:30 UTC and Wed 17:00 UTC. I'll post invites once Helen publishes the timeline. Please encourage managers to drop in if they haven't calibrated before.

eng-manager-ryan: Will forward the blurb and encourage my leads to attend one of the refresh sessions. One more ask: can appeals be handled within 48h after final calibration notes are published? We need a predictable window for teams.

mike_hr: Yes 48h appeals window post-publication. Appeals should be one paragraph from the manager with supporting evidence; HR triages and records outcomes.

helen_peopleops: Perfect. I'll publish the timeline + form link tomorrow AM and post a short FAQ with the exception flow. Thanks for the quick replies :white_check_mark:
